name: Fadi Kanaan
headline: Partnerships & Strategic Alliances | SaaS
about: As a Director of Strategic Partnerships with over a decade of experience, I drive market expansion and significant revenue growth through high-impact, partner-led sales models in tech environments. I excel at cultivating C-level relationships, defining Go-to-Market strategies, and empowering partners in key ecosystems like Salesforce, Microsoft, Azure, and AWS across North America and Europe, fostering deep business and technical success.

experiences.description: Neuvote has pioneered a one-of-a-kind Hybrid Mobile Voting Platform that addresses the challenges to online voting.

As Indirect Channel Manager at Librestream, I defined and executed global partner channel and Go-to-Market strategies, driving substantial revenue growth. My responsibilities included global partner recruitment, complex contract negotiations, and fostering cross-functional collaboration to ensure market penetration and partner success.

At ExpandIT, I spearheaded pipeline growth and strategic sales initiatives, cultivating strong relationships with Microsoft Dynamics resellers to drive a highly effective partner-led sales model. My role included enabling VARs to effectively promote solutions, conducting workshops that significantly increased deal closure, and providing strategic forecasts to senior leadership.

As an Account Manager at Titanium, I managed and grew customer and carrier relationships within a vast North American network. My role involved negotiating freight coverage and pricing, troubleshooting, and collaborating with key 3PLs and eCommerce warehousing facilities.
As Owner of Motivay Entertainment, I led all facets of event management and successfully secured sponsorships from major consumer brands, driving revenue and public exposure.
